question: How do I work with trip bags?

youtubeLink.caption: Plantour Trip Bags
youtubeLink.description: This video explains how to work with trip bags

sections.title: Add a trip bag
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to create a bag that belongs only to the currently selected trip.
items: Click the Dashboard toolbar button, expand the Trip section and click on the Trips link
Select the trip you want to work in.
Open the Trip section again and select Bags.
Click the Add button with the plus icon. The Add Trip Bag form opens.
Enter the bag name. You can also fill optional fields such as label, notes, whether a packing list is included, and bag weight with its unit.
Plantour saves the bag in that trip and returns you to the Trip Bags list.

sections.title: Update a trip bag
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to change a bag that already belongs to the selected trip.
items: Select the bag you want to update so it is highlighted.
Click the Update button with the pencil icon. The Edit Trip Bag form opens.
Change the fields you need, such as name, label, notes, packing-list inclusion, or bag weight and unit.
Plantour saves the updated bag and returns you to the Trip Bags list.

sections.title: Delete a trip bag
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when you want to remove a bag from the selected trip.
items: Select the bag you want to remove so it is highlighted.
Click the Delete button with the trash icon.
Plantour removes the bag from that trip`s Trip Bags list.
sections.afterHtml: Trip bags are trip-specific. They are used to organize where trip items are packed inside the selected trip. After creating or updating bags, continue with What options do I have to pack the trip items?.
